errors.evidence: The description misinterprets the absolute counts shown in the legend as percentages. The value for "Изцяло е интегриран" is 10 responses, not 10%. The total number of responses is 87 (10+24+25+8+20), so 10 is approximately 11.5%. This error is repeated for all five categories.
The description misinterprets the absolute count of 24 as 24%. The correct percentage is approximately 27.6% (24 out of 87).
The description misinterprets the absolute count of 25 as 25%. The correct percentage is approximately 28.7% (25 out of 87).
The description misinterprets the absolute count of 8 as 8%. The correct percentage is approximately 9.2% (8 out of 87).
The description misinterprets the absolute count of 20 as 20%. The correct percentage is approximately 23% (20 out of 87).
